card.title: The Ceremony Requires More
card.instruction: Treat every ordinary step as only the beginning of an elaborate ceremony, adding necessary details whenever anyone tries to finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you blow out your birthday candle, we need a witness candle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can that be the last one? The ice cream's melting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, once we acknowledge its service.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say thank you. Then we eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Light the acknowledgement candle so everyone can see you thanking it.

mechanism: A turns each apparent end of the birthday-candle ceremony into the start of another required acknowledgment.
confusable: Unlike a fixed ritual with an eventual completion condition, A adds a new necessary layer whenever B tries to finish.
comparison: The candle alternative makes thanks require its own lighting; the shoelace alternative makes a completed double knot require an introduction.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
